name: brevity-node
description: Brevity-inspired micro framework for Node.js (TypeScript edition)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-cache && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-debug && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-viewer && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-validation && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-web && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-views && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-islands && npm run build --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-islands-svelte
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run docs:check
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && node --import tsx --test test/*.test.ts && npm run docs:check
scripts.publish:dry-run: npm run build:packages && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-cache && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-debug && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-viewer && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-validation && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-web && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-views && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-islands && npm pack --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-islands-svelte
scripts.publish:all: npm run build:packages && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-cache --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-debug --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-viewer --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-plugin-validation --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-web --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-views --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-islands --access public && npm publish --workspace @portablesheep/brevity-islands-svelte --access public
